title: A Pattern of Helping
description: A Pattern of Helping — The Townstons wiki
html:
Quest Giver: Billy Ray

Quest Type: Collect

Quest Description: Kentucky Jim was kind of a jerk, but swapping tickets is working out well. Maybe the next person in the Dew Valley help queue also needs a favor?

Quest Reward: None listed

Return to: Billy Ray

Repeatable: No

Following Quest: But Was It Lucky For the Wolf

Zone: Dew Valley

In-game text

Journal text, offer, and turn-in as they appeared in game.

Journal: Kentucky Jim was kind of a jerk, but swapping tickets is working out well. Maybe the next person in the Dew Valley help queue also needs a favor?

Offer:

Thanks for finding the Hermit's Hoop. Was Samford mad? Pfft, whatever. He's so clueless, I bet my retainer that he gave you a different ring in exchange.

Eh, did you say something? Oh, my *ticket*! Obviously, I merely forgot to give you my ticket in exchange for that favor you did me, as far as you know.

Here's my ticket, #2814. ...Unless you feel guilty for cutting in front of me and want me to keep my ticket. You don't? Fine, whatever.

Turn-in:

Well, hello there! My name is Billy Ray. You say you would like to give me your ticket and a favor in exchange for my ticket? Splendid! I do have a task in mind that you can help me accomplish.

Objectives:

  • Ticket #2814 ×1

Level range: 1–5
